name: roi_x_vf_pca_gender_patient_pilot_b500
description: ROI X plus one fixed VF PC plus gender paired VCTR patient-cluster bootstrap pilot.
notes: Exploratory B=500 patient-cluster bootstrap diagnostics, not final manuscript inference.
K=1 follows the modal nested-CV selection in v2_roi_five_model (four of five outer folds).
The full-sample patient-equal PCA basis is fixed across bootstrap replicates so VF_PC1 has a common interpretation.
The intervals are conditional on the fixed PCA representation and do not include PCA-basis selection uncertainty.
Every sampled patient retains all visits and both eyes.
ROI S, R, h, and hbar are inherited from the X-only-selected prediction model.
A(t) uses 95% pointwise percentile intervals; beta uses parameterwise percentile intervals.
